verdict.rationale: Meltano's docs make a single generic claim of "Built-in pipeline monitoring and alerts". That plausibly covers being warned about pipeline problems, but nothing describes per-table freshness or alerts tied to a missed schedule. Scheduling via Airflow and incremental state tracking are related features, but neither delivers freshness visibility or cadence-miss warnings. Missing for 10: per-destination-table freshness/last-loaded visibility, documented alerting when a scheduled pipeline misses its expected cadence, details on how alerts are configured or delivered, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an analytics engineer, I can tell how fresh each destination table is and get warned when a pipeline misses its expected cadence
